source.probe: Thai advances per glyph from hmtx, Regular and Bold; Latin ratio 0.644 regular / 0.657 bold

note:
Word for Mac ships Cordia New and TH SarabunPSK (DFonts) and lays every other Thai
family out as Cordia New (probe 2026-11-03, doc2docx sample 059: 16pt TH SarabunIT9
paces 18.4pt = Cordia hhea 1.147). macOS has neither and Chromium's Thonburi fallback
advances ~1.75x wider at a 1em design size. The Thai faces (Regular and Bold) are Noto
Sans Thai with every outline scaled horizontally to the Word advance of its code point
and vertically to the small Thai design size, mark anchors moved along, advances and
vertical metrics rewritten (tools/build-thai-font.py); the Latin repertoire is
Liberation Sans size-adjusted to the Word face's Latin advances (hmtx sentence ratio
over a mixed-case English sample).
